exercises.title: Part 1 · 1
exercises.prompt: How often do you see your neighbours? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: Do you invite your neighbours to your home? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: Do you think you are a good neighbour? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: Has a neighbour ever helped you? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe a very difficult task that you succeeded in doing as part of your work or studies. You should say: what task you did why this task was very difficult how you worked on this task and explain how you felt when you had successfully completed this task.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 1
exercises.prompt: What are the most difficult jobs that people do?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: Why do you think some people choose to do difficult jobs?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: Do you agree or disagree that all jobs are difficult sometimes?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: How important is it for everyone to have a goal in their personal life?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 5
exercises.prompt: Is it always necessary to work hard in order to achieve career success?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: Do you think that successful people are always happy people?
